question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.

Sheena comes of an **affluent **family.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"affluent"** means having a great deal of money; wealthy. (धनी)

 
 
• **Example: **Sheena comes from an affluent family that owns several properties.
 
 
 
• **"Poor" **refers to lacking sufficient money to live at a standard considered comfortable or normal in a society. (गरीब)
 
 
• **Example: **The charity organization aims to help poor families improve their living conditions.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'affluent' **is **'poor'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Backward **(पिछड़ा): Having made less progress than is normal or expected.

 
 
• **Example:** The backward regions of the country need more development projects.
 
 
 
• **Infamous **(कुख्यात): Well known for some bad quality or deed.
 
 
• **Example: **The criminal was infamous for his daring robberies.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary** (साधारण): With no special or distinctive features; normal.
 
 
• **Example:** The restaurant serves ordinary food, nothing special.
